Insecurity Insight – Monitoring incidents around the world affecting aid, health care, education, and protection. 
 
 
Protection in Danger 
Monthly News Brief 
May 2026 
 
Due to the suspension of funding affecting our Protection in Danger project, all related monitoring, data collection, analysi s, 
and reporting activities have been discontinued. As a result, the Protection in Danger Monthly News Brief will no longer be 
updated or published, and no further incident data will be collected or made available. We thank our contributors and readers 
for their support and engagement with this work. 
 
Past editions: April; March; February; January; December; November; October; September; August; July; June; All
